items.difficulty_reason: Splitting lemma (statement 2096-2106, proof 2108-2242): a complete induction with an explicit stripping procedure, a kernel-membership claim proven step by step through the simplicial relations and the uniqueness remark, and a reassembly into the degenerate-simplex normal form matched against the unique factorization of surjections; the only 'clear' spot is the definitional base case n = 0 recorded in the notes. H3: 135-line hands-on simplicial abelian group computation.
